summary: This Form 8-K reports that Esquire Financial Holdings held a special meeting on June 23, 2026, to approve the issuance of its common stock to shareholders of Signature Bancorporation under a merger agreement. Shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favor (6,568,618 for vs. 9,444 against). The merger is structured as a stock-for-stock transaction, exchange ratio announced concurrently. No price, premium, advisors, or regulatory timeline disclosed. A joint press release confirms the merger and meeting results. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory approvals; risk-arb focuses on stock consideration volatility.
